name: 小糸
text:
ひ、雛菜ちゃん
廊下走っちゃだめだよ……！
trans:
Y-You shouldn't run in the hallway,
Hinana-chan......!

name: 雛菜
text:
やは～！
透先輩もうホームルーム終わった？
trans:
Yaha～!　Is homeroom already over for you guys,
Toru-senpai?

name: 円香
text: 何？　迷惑なんだけど
trans: And what is it, you're bothering others.

name: 雛菜
text:
もう放課後～ってかんじだから
ちょっとうるさくても平気だよ～
trans:
Everyone's already in an after-school mood anyways,
so it's fine to be noisy～

name: 雛菜
text:
雛菜、一日で今がいちばん
元気かも～！
trans:
Now's the time of the day when Hinana's feeling
the best～!

name: 円香
trans: What are you doing here, bringing Koito along.

name: 雛菜
text:
透先輩に帰ろ～って言いに来る途中で
小糸ちゃんいたから
trans:
I was on my way to ask Toru-senpai to walk home
together, and Koito-chan was there too.

name: 小糸
text:
円香ちゃんも
一緒に帰ろう……！
trans: Let's go home together too, Madoka-chan......!

name: 円香
text:
……帰る方向一緒なんだから
嫌でもそうなるでしょ
trans:
......My way home's the same, so that'll happen no
matter if I want to or not.

name: 小糸
text:
な、なんか小学校の時の
登校班みたいだよね……！
trans:
F-feels like back in elementary school when we'd go
to school together on walking buses......!

name: 雛菜
text:
は～い！
雛菜先頭やる～！
trans:
De～finitely!
Hinana'll will be in front～!

name: 小糸
text:
班長さんと副班長さんは
上級生がやるんじゃなかったっけ……！
trans:
The driver and and the conductor should be upper
classmen...!

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃあ透先輩が先頭で～
雛菜が２番目！
trans:
Then Toru-senpai will lead～
And Hinana will come second!

name: 小糸
text:
わ、わたし
日誌出して来なきゃだから……！
trans: I-I gotta go submit my journal......!

name: 小糸
text:
だから雛菜ちゃん
廊下は走っちゃ──……
trans:
Ah, I've already said it just now, but you shouldn't
run in the hallway, Hinana-chan──......

name: 体育教師
text: 市川、廊下を走るんじゃない！
trans: Don't run in the hallway, Ichikawa!

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
怒られちゃった～！

name: 透
text:
ふふっ
雛菜、有名人

name: 透
text:
２年の先生じゃん
あの人

name: 雛菜
text:
あとでさっきの先生にも
お菓子あげないとだね～！
trans: We gotta give that teacher some snacks later, too～!

name: 小糸
text:
あ、あの体育の先生に……！？
な、なんで……

name: 雛菜
text:
だって、怖い人に会ったら
お菓子渡さなきゃいけないでしょ？
trans:
Cos, if you meet a scary person, you gotta give them
some snacks, right?
